payload.explanation: Diagnostic report_ae6577662312 identifies the business request (session_894e2ed6d2a4) blocked on transactionid waiting for session_a5bdb844d657, which holds an uncommitted UPDATE on the same inventory row and is idle in transaction. State report_0a34d4c1ca58 confirms session_a5bdb844d657 is eligible for rollback_session, while the business request and session_e7bf003b7f40 are not actionable. Rolling back the blocker releases the row lock so the decrement can complete; the business request must not be modified directly.
